name: Content plan
summary: A marketing lead with a few hours a week gets a content plan built on the questions buyers really ask: one subject for each question worth answering, the formats those hours can carry, a ranked list of what to write next, and what is held or left out, each with its reason.

sources.title: Its own content planning guide, used in its marketing work.

sources.contribution: The content strategy method our guide rewrote: asking what time and formats the team has, subjects drawn from buyers' questions in sales and support, each question kept in the buyer's words with its source, how often a question comes up as a sign of priority, questions placed at buyer stages through to after the purchase, pieces meant to be found told apart from pieces meant to be passed on, a stated addition over existing answers before a piece is planned, candidates rated before they are ranked, one piece cut into shorter ones, and the owned channel as the destination.
